name: supergoal
description: Plan and autonomously build a software task end-to-end. Recons the codebase, applies preloaded memory, decomposes into the right number of phases, gets one confirmation, then prepares a single ready-to-paste /goal command that drives execution to completion with built-in retry, fix-spec recovery, and per-phase memory writeback. Cross-platform: ships parity PowerShell (.ps1) and POSIX (.sh) helpers. Adapted for Windows from supergoal by Robert Courson.
